title: UFOs never discussed at the top of NSA and ODNI

tellings.quote:
No. And I'll tell you that inside the
highest levels of the intelligence
community, this is not something we
spent a fth second thinking about

plain: Eric Haseltine, a former senior official at the NSA and at the Office of the Director of National Intelligence, which oversees US spy agencies, says UFOs never came up at the top of those agencies in the 2000s. He tells Michels that at the highest levels of the intelligence community "this is not something we spent a fifth of a second thinking about." If so, the subject was not on the radar of the people at the top, whatever was going on below them.
